idea-plugin.name: SQLAlchemy Log Free
idea-plugin.description:
SQLAlchemy Log Free restores SQLAlchemy SQL logs into whole executable SQL statements with parameters automatically filled.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Interception: Automatically captures SQL logs output by the SQLAlchemy engine in PyCharm / IntelliJ execution consoles.
  • Smart Parameter Binding: Replaces placeholders (?, %s, %(name)s, :name, $1) with Python bound parameters.
  • Complex Python Type Support: Accurately formats None, datetime, date, time, Decimal, UUID, strings with quotes, booleans, and batch lists.
  • Batch / Executemany Expansion: Expands multi-row insert/update parameters into individual executable SQL queries.
  • Transaction Monitoring: Visualizes BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK transaction states.
  • Dedicated Tool Window: View queries in a dedicated dockable "SQLAlchemy Log" console with SQL syntax coloring.
  • Pretty Print Formatter: Toggle automatic indentation and query formatting.
  • SQL Navigation: Jump between SQL queries using Previous / Next SQL actions.
  • Filters & Colors: Ignore noisy queries (e.g., PRAGMA, table_info) and customize query colors (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

Usage:

  1. Click Tools -> SQLAlchemy Log Plugin to open the log window.
  2. Or right click inside any execution console and select SQLAlchemy Log Plugin.
  3. Run your Python application (FastAPI, Flask, Django with SQLAlchemy, or script with echo=True). Executable queries will appear in real time!
